{{Quote|Bah! Me, the best mining pilot in the galaxy, stuck here an the lost planet of the furballs by Imperial order! This is no place for Flash Harrison, mighty pilot!|Flash Harrison|<ref name="SWG:RotW">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''</ref>}}
'''Flash Harrison''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] pilot that lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He worked as a mining [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] for the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]].

==Biography==
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] Harrison was working on a space mining project in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]]. When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] suspected him to be a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] sympathizer, his ship was confiscated. Harrison was stuck on the [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Wookiee world]] — and he couldn't stand [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]].

He finally met a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] in [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]] who agreed to deliver a message to CEC representative [[Thom Steele]] on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]].

==Behind the scenes==
Flash Harrison is a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']], the second addon to [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. He can be found on the first level of the great tree in Kachirho. Harrison asks the player to travel to Talus and talk to Thom Steele, starting a quest that introduces the player to [[:w:c:swg:Space mining|space mining]], a new feature of ''Rage of the Wookiees''.
